paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of different components in terms of NDCG@10. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis in the order: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical axis is labeled with values ranging from 0.05 to 0.25, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The bar for "Ours" is orange and reaches approximately 0.21, while the other three bars are blue, with "- critiquing" at around 0.19, "- scoring" at about 0.07, and "- ranking" at roughly 0.12. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and there is no specific sorting order or visual emphasis on any particular bar. The chart provides a visual representation of the relative performance of each component, allowing for a straightforward comparison of their NDCG@10 values.
